data.narrative:
Diode is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Davide Asnaghi and Lenny Khazan, having raised $10M+ to date. The sector comparison set includes 9 private peers (including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI) and 1 public comparable (277810.KQ), though the narrow peer universe limits precision in peer-median valuation work.

Given data constraints, stage-progression analysis is the applicable triangulation method. Using total capital raised of $10M as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $25M. This single-method approach produces a median point estimate of $25M, with a reasonable sensitivity range of $21M (low) to $29M (high) reflecting uncertainty in multiplier selection and the company's relative positioning within its cohort.

The analysis is materially constrained by insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comps in robotics and manufacturing—peer-median methodology could not be applied without risking meaningless aggregation across dissimilar valuation tiers. The $21M–$29M range should be treated as preliminary pending access to more granular founder-round and series-A data from comparable companies at similar development stages. Stage and market timing remain the primary valuation sensitivities.
